default.policy: Manual import only until source terms, robots policy, access and copyright permissions have been reviewed.

tkdl.policy: Public directory pointer only. Restricted records are not ingested.

pct.policy: Manual import of WIPO-authored PCT FAQ text only. WIPO open-access terms checked 2026-09-26: https://www.wipo.int/en/web/terms-of-use (CC BY 4.0, excluding third-party material and logos). Retain WIPO attribution and original URL; generated summaries are adaptations, not WIPO endorsement. Document extraction/applicability review remains separate.

wipo.policy: WIPO-authored text only, CC BY 4.0 under https://www.wipo.int/en/web/terms-of-use checked 2026-09-26; retain attribution, mark generated explanations as adaptations, exclude third-party material and logos. Manual review imports only; this is not blanket crawling permission.

ema.policy: EMA-owned text may be reproduced/distributed with attribution under https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/about-us/about-website/legal-notice checked 2026-09-26. Exclude third-party materials and logos. Manual review imports only; this is not blanket crawling permission.

mhra.policy: Crown copyright text under Open Government Licence v3.0 linked from the GOV.UK page footer. Retain attribution and source link; exclude third-party content and marks. Checked 2026-09-26. Manual review imports only; this is not blanket crawling permission.

fda.policy: FDA-authored government text is public domain under https://www.fda.gov/about-fda/about-website/website-policies checked 2026-09-26. Retain attribution and current original source link. Manual review imports only; this is not blanket crawling permission.

patents.policy: Manual import of official legislative text for source-grounded research explanations, with original commentary and attribution. Copyright Act 1957 section 52(1)(q)(ii) permits legislative text together with commentary or other original matter; confirmed against IP India Copyright Act text. This covers the named Act only, not government FAQs, photographs, logos, paid annotations or registry data. Do not publish a standalone copied statute library. Permission basis recorded 2026-09-26; professional legal review before public release remains advisable.

cdsco.policy: Narrow manual import of the section 3 statutory definitions reproduced in the Traditional Drugs document container for accompanying original research explanations, under Copyright Act section 52(1)(q)(ii), with authority and locator attribution. This is a statutory quotation basis, NOT general permission to reproduce CDSCO website content: its copyright policy requires permission for other materials. No logos, photographs, other guidance, registry content or bulk site copying. Checked 2026-09-26.

nba.policy: Manual imports of the named official Gazette legislation only, for source-grounded explanations with attribution. Legislative text is used with original commentary under Copyright Act section 52(1)(q)(ii); this is not blanket permission to copy the NBA site. Current applicability and later amendments are reviewed separately. Checked 2026-09-27.

fssai.policy: Manual import of the named FSSAI-authored Gazette regulation. FSSAI's copyright policy permits accurate reproduction with prominent source acknowledgement and excludes third-party material. No logos or third-party content. Checked 2026-09-27.
